metadata.case_name: CHIU MO YUEN v. JAMES CATERING EQUIPMENT LTD. AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_after: same occupation; unable to perform heavy duty work

injuries.description: fracture of his left distal radius
source: he fell, suffering a fracture of his left distal radius and a laceration on his left palm.

The Plaintiff was admitted to Tuen Mun hospital on 19 August 1995 with a fracture of his left side distal radius and with a laceration to his left palm. As emergency operation under general anaesthetic was carried out that same day for fracture fixation and wound suturing. The Plaintiff was discharged on 21 August and he was readmitted for removal of the external fixator on 4 October 1995. The fracture healed uneventfully but the Plaintiff complained of persistent pain over his wrist. A medical assessment board granted the Plaintiff 10% permanent disability on 16 October 1996.
